panels.scene_en: a spaceship cockpit with red alarm lights flashing

bubbles.text: Řídící kabina vesmírné lodi. Bliká alarm.

panels.scene_en: Viktorie kneels at an open engine service panel, wiping oil from her forehead

bubbles.speaker: viktorie
bubbles.text: Pixeli, co se děje? Hlavní počítač nehlásí žádnou chybu!

panels.scene_en: the ginger two-tailed cat with bristling fur jumps onto the main control panel, both tails pointing at the right fan
the outer hull of a spaceship in space, Earth glowing far away
Viktorie in a space helmet clings magnetically to the hull replacing a burnt part, the cat in a tiny helmet floats beside her holding a tool in his mouth
Captain Daniel speaks into his headset on the station bridge, worried

bubbles.speaker: daniel
bubbles.text: Viktorie, zbývají dvě minuty do průletu meteoritickým polem! Zvládáš to?

panels.scene_en: close-up of Viktorie inside her helmet tightening a bolt, smiling with determination

bubbles.speaker: viktorie
bubbles.text: Už to bude, tati! Pixel našel uvolněný kabel dřív než senzory!

panels.scene_en: the ginger cat floats in his tiny space helmet next to the ship, eyes closed, purring
